description: Weekly trends in Claude Code cost, effort, agents and adoption, from the hourly OTel metrics. Covers every user, including those whose clients send no logs.

links.title: Claude Usage
links.tooltip: Hourly Claude Code usage, cost and acceptance for the selected range

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **Weeks** start on Monday (UTC). Only weeks that have ended and fall fully inside the time range are shown, so the current week appears once it ends.
- **Coverage:** every panel comes from the hourly OTel metrics, which every Claude Code client sends, including clients that send no logs. Metric history starts on 2026-09-24.
- **Effort and agents** are recorded per request from the hourly backfill onwards. Cost without them shows as *N/A* effort and as *Main thread*.
- **Filters:** Project and Claude Code OTel teams narrow every panel. Developer narrows every panel except *Top 10% Share* and *Spend Concentration*, which compare people with each other.

panels.description: Estimated cost per 1,000 lines Claude Code added over the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 1000 * c.cost / NULLIF(l.lines_added, 0) AS "Cost per 1k lines added",
  c.opus / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS "Opus share of cost",
  c.subagent / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS "Subagent share of cost"
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(model) LIKE '%opus%' THEN estimated_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS opus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN agent_name <> '' THEN estimated_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS subagent
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) c
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS lines_added
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) l

panels.title: Subagent Share

panels.description: Share of the range's estimated cost spent by the 10% of users who spent the most. Ignores the Developer filter.

targets.rawSql:
-- Ignores the developer filter: a share of spend across people is always 100% for one person.
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.10 * n) THEN cost ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(MAX(total), 0) AS "Top 10% share of cost"
FROM (
  SELECT cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n, SUM(cost) OVER () AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
    FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
    WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
      AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING SUM(estimated_cost_usd) > 0
  ) u
) r

panels.title: Top 10% Share

panels.description: Users with a Claude Code session or active time in the last completed week of the range.

targets.rawSql:
-- A user is active on a UTC day with any session or active time; weekdays are Monday to Friday.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(hour_start) AS d, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND (session_count > 0 OR active_time_seconds > 0)
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(d), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(d) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT user) AS users, SUM(WEEKDAY(d) < 5) AS weekdays
  FROM days
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  COALESCE(k.users, 0) AS "Weekly active users",
  k.weekdays / NULLIF(k.users, 0) AS "Active weekdays per user"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly k ON k.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly Users

panels.description: Bars: estimated cost per 1,000 lines Claude Code added in each completed week (left axis). Line: Opus models' share of that week's cost (right axis). Cost and lines are summed separately over the same users.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; cost and lines are summed separately and joined on the week.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
cost AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(model) LIKE '%opus%' THEN estimated_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS opus
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
),
added AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, SUM(lines_added) AS lines_added
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  1000 * c.cost / NULLIF(l.lines_added, 0) AS "Cost per 1k lines added",
  c.opus / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS "Opus share of cost"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN cost c ON c.week = w.week
LEFT JOIN added l ON l.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost per 1k Lines Added and Opus Share (Weekly)

panels.description: Each bar is one completed week's estimated cost, split by the effort level its requests reported. N/A is cost whose requests reported no effort.

targets.rawSql:
-- Completed Monday-start UTC weeks only; 'N/A' is cost whose requests reported no effort.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
e AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, CASE effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE 'N/A' END AS effort, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Low' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Low",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Medium' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Medium",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'High' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "High",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'XHigh' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "XHigh",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Max' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Max",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'N/A' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "N/A"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN e ON e.week = w.week
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:

WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (

),
e AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, CASE effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE 'N/A' END AS effort, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Low' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Low",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Medium' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Medium",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'High' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "High",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'XHigh' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "XHigh",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'Max' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "Max",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.effort = 'N/A' THEN e.cost ELSE 0 END) AS "N/A"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN e ON e.week = w.week
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly Active Users and Active Weekdays per User

panels.description: Share of each completed week's estimated cost spent by the top 10% and the top 25% of users by cost that week. A rising line means spend is concentrating in fewer people. Ignores the Developer filter.

targets.rawSql:
-- Ignores the developer filter: a share of spend across people is always 100% for one person.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING SUM(estimated_cost_usd) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT week, cost,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY week ORDER BY cost DESC) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY week) AS n,
    SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY week) AS total
  FROM per_user
),
shares AS (
  SELECT week,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.10 * n) THEN cost ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total) AS top10,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.25 * n) THEN cost ELSE 0 END) / MAX(total) AS top25,
    MAX(n) AS users
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY week
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  s.top10 AS "Top 10% of users",
  s.top25 AS "Top 25% of users",
  s.users AS "Users with cost"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN shares s ON s.week = w.week
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Spend Concentration (Weekly)

panels.description: Estimated cost in each completed week by the agent that made the requests. Main thread is the conversation itself. The 8 named subagents with the most cost in the range have their own series, and the rest are grouped as Other.

targets.rawSql:
-- The 8 named agents with the most cost in the range get their own series; the rest are grouped as Other.
WITH RECURSIVE wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
),
a AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, agent_name, SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
  WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
    AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
top_agents AS (
  SELECT agent_name FROM (
    SELECT agent_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC, agent_name) AS rn
    FROM a JOIN weeks USING (week)
    WHERE agent_name <> ''
    GROUP BY agent_name
  ) t WHERE rn <= 8
)
SELECT TIMESTAMP(w.week) + INTERVAL 84 HOUR AS "time",
  CASE WHEN a.agent_name = '' THEN 'Main thread' WHEN t.agent_name IS NOT NULL THEN a.agent_name ELSE 'Other' END AS metric,
  SUM(a.cost) AS value
FROM weeks w
JOIN a ON a.week = w.week
LEFT JOIN top_agents t ON t.agent_name = a.agent_name
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Cost by Agent (Weekly)

panels.description: Estimated cost for each Claude Code OTel team and agent over the selected range, with each agent's share of its team's cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT team_slug AS "Team",
  CASE WHEN agent_name = '' THEN 'Main thread' ELSE agent_name END AS "Agent",
  SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost",
  SUM(estimated_cost_usd) / SUM(SUM(estimated_cost_usd)) OVER (PARTITION BY team_slug) AS "Share of team cost"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
  AND connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY team_slug, agent_name
HAVING SUM(estimated_cost_usd) > 0
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(names.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity WHERE connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  UNION
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_model_usage WHERE connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  UNION
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(user_email, ''), user_key) AS user FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage WHERE connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
) u
LEFT JOIN (
  -- Resolve each email to a person's full name from accounts. gitextractor rows (id = email) are preferred;
  -- only names that look like a full name (contain a space) are used, otherwise the email is shown.
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email)) AS email_key,
         COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a_n.id = a_n.email THEN n_n.name END), MAX(n_n.name)) AS full_name
  FROM accounts a_n
  JOIN (SELECT id, TRIM(REPLACE(full_name, UNHEX('E2808B'), '')) AS name FROM accounts) n_n
    ON n_n.id = a_n.id AND n_n.name LIKE '% %' AND n_n.name NOT LIKE '%@%'
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(a_n.email), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(a_n.email))
) names ON names.email_key = LOWER(TRIM(u.user))
ORDER BY 1;
